archives.text:
# Detailed milestone plan

ROADMAP.md is the summary. This plan defines engineering merge gates and milestone acceptance, not claims of completion. Binding decision D-008 separates them: routine PRs require compilation, automated tests, exact-head CI, independent review, applicable dependency security/license checks and installer generation when packaging changes. Manual acceptance is required at designated milestone boundaries, not each intermediate PR. Record any deferred tests and their target milestone. See CHAT_HANDOFF.md for current evidence.

| Milestone | Dependencies | Acceptance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RUST-00/01 foundation | None | Continuity rules, lockfiles, exact-head native builds/tests, installer generation and independent review; manual Windows/Linux install/launch/close and prototype comparison or approved deviation deferred to RUST-02 under D-008 |
| RUST-02 workspace | RUST-01 | Menus, dockable panels, shortcuts, tabs and persistent workspace state; manual Windows/Linux install/launch/close, command interaction and visual acceptance including deferred RUST-01 prototype comparison or approved deviation |
| RUST-03A project model | Independent | Framework-neutral versioned model, validation, deterministic serialization, schemas, fixtures and tests |
| RUST-03B engineering operations | RUST-03A | Transactional commands, project storage, undo/redo, recovery and persistence tests |
| RUST-04 layout editor | RUST-02, RUST-03B | Visual component operations, nested constraints, alignment and responsive preview; manual desktop designer acceptance |
| RUST-05 interoperability | RUST-04 | Authorized import fixtures and equivalent Compose rendering verified across target profiles; manual interoperability acceptance |
| RUST-06 engineering systems | RUST-03B | Tags, drivers, bindings, alarms, recipes, search and isolated simulation tests |
| RUST-07 deployment | RUST-05, relevant RUST-06 | Standalone bundles and project-only publishing, pairing and trust verification with platform-specific tests; manual deployment acceptance |
| RUST-08 migration acceptance | Prior milestones | Compatibility, installation and acceptance on Windows/Linux/Android runtime targets |
| RUST-09 advanced engineering | Stable core | Optional AI, vector/3D features; separate scoped validation |

RUST-00/01 merged as 7a07d7e (PR #1); manual acceptance deferred to RUST-02. RUST-03A merged as 0ccf044 (PR #2). RUST-03B merged as 101c8f3 (PR #3), exact-head core/desktop/handoff CI passed. RUST-02A/B merged (PRs #5 and #6); RUST-02C merged (PR #8, 4ca18a59); manual desktop acceptance remains open in #10. RUST-04A draft preparation is limited to nested flow insertion and sibling ordering; no dependency acceptance or visual parity claimed. See NATIVE_PERSISTENCE.md. See WORKSPACE_IMPLEMENTATION.md for slices and outstanding acceptance. Issue #4 remains open. No filesystem containment, runtime or production acceptance claimed.

## CI-02 — Change-aware CI (merged; follow-up validation pending)
Merged PR #14 (`39eba35`); full CI and independent review passed. Documentation-only routing passed on PR #9 (zero artifacts). Remaining evidence: independent manual dispatch. Acceptance criteria: regression tests for change classification, exact-head full CI for workflow changes, independent review, verify required check contexts and manual installer path, demonstrate documentation-only routing with no installer uploads. Keep handoff and applicable dependency checks mandatory. See CI_RUNNER_POLICY.md; no milestone or release acceptance implied.

## Reuse track (REUSE-01/02A/02B merged; REUSE-02C pending)
See reuse/REUSE_MILESTONE_PLAN.md and reuse/AUDIT_SUMMARY.md. REUSE-01 merged as `238fd18` (PR #9), audit-only; REUSE-02A verifies pinned source, rights, disclosure and dependencies before import. Later bridge, model, runtime and deployment decisions remain open. Preserve both runtime delivery modes, generated Kotlin/Compose evaluation, simulation freedom, and independent production acceptance.

REUSE-02A: see reuse/REUSE_02A_PREFLIGHT.md for verified inputs, limited screening and outstanding transfer gates.

REUSE-02B source-only import follows merged #15 and private #57; see crates/hmi-engine/PROVENANCE.md. Exact-head Windows/Linux test-server, notice inventory, advisory gate and independent review required before merge; no bridge or production/release acceptance.

RUST-06A PR #7 reconciled against merged REUSE-02B (`78f3a64`), reviewed with six new regression tests (50 total); exact-head Desktop CI, handoff and dedicated strict audit still required. REUSE-02C starts only after tag foundation merge and applicable O-5/bridge decisions; bounded delivery, supervision, numeric safety and simulation acceptance before actual PLC work.

REUSE-02C.1 merged in PR #17 (`dbdeeb2`) after exact-head CI and independent review. REUSE-02C.2 PR #18 candidate: typed dispatch, bounded/coalesced subscriptions and explicit generation-scoped authoritative baseline for isolated read-only loopback; 81 local tests passed including real child, exact-head hosted CI and independent review pending. General EngineDriver and physical-source semantics remain separate. See reuse/REUSE_02C2_BRIDGE_DISPATCH.md. No production/physical acceptance.

REUSE-02C.2 merged in PR #18 (9dc343b) after exact-head hosted real-child tests and independent review. REUSE-02C.3 candidate connects the supervised loopback engine to TagEngine with checked scalar translation, cancellation and fresh-generation recovery. Independent review and exact-head CI required; general mapping, write termination and physical/UI acceptance remain separate. See reuse/REUSE_02C3_ENGINE_DRIVER.md.

# Milestone plan

| ID | Scope | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RUST-00 | Repository rules, architecture, CI | Merged |
| RUST-01 | Desktop shell, typed commands, Windows/Linux development installers | Merged; manual acceptance deferred to RUST-02 |
| RUST-02 | Menus, docking, tabs, shortcuts, workspace persistence | RUST-02A/B/C merged; desktop acceptance open (#10) |
| RUST-03A | Versioned project model, validation, serialization and schema | Merged |
| RUST-03B | Storage, command transactions, undo/redo | Merged |
| RUST-04 | Interactive semantic layout designer | RUST-04A draft preparation; acceptance dependency open |
| RUST-05 | Existing project import and Compose rendering parity | Planned |
| RUST-06 | Drivers, tags, bindings, alarms, recipes, search, simulation | RUST-06A tag foundation in review (PR #7) |
| RUST-07 | Standalone export and project-only publishing to paired runtimes | Planned |
| RUST-08 | Migration acceptance and installers | Planned |
| RUST-09 | Local agent, advanced graphics, 3D | Planned |

## RUST-00/01 acceptance
- Review rules and architecture; select license before distributing migrated code.
- Current implementation is a reconstruction; original HTML fidelity comparison or approved deviation deferred to RUST-02 under D-008.
- Verify committed npm and Cargo lockfiles and locked CI installs/builds.
- Verify exact-head frontend build, Rust tests, Windows MSI and Linux DEB builds.
- Independent review and applicable security/license checks required before engineering merge.
- Manual install/launch/close on both OSs, command interaction and visual acceptance are deferred to RUST-02, not claimed passed. Routine PRs do not require manual owner acceptance; see D-008.
- No production capabilities or private code transfer.

## CI-02 — Change-aware CI
Merged in PR #14 (`39eba35`): applicable tests, stable engineering gate, pinned Rust dependency/compilation cache and on-demand Windows/Linux installers with three-day retention. Documentation-only routing demonstrated on PR #9 (zero artifacts); see docs/CI_RUNNER_POLICY.md.

## HMI Forge reuse track (REUSE-01/02A/02B merged; REUSE-02C pending tag foundation)
REUSE-01 merged as `238fd18` (PR #9); scoped planning baseline, not transfer clearance. REUSE-02A evidence and open gates: docs/reuse/REUSE_02A_PREFLIGHT.md. REUSE-02A pinned-source rights/provenance, advisory and sensitive-content preflight before any transfer; REUSE-02 bridge proposed under RUST-06; REUSE-03/04 map to RUST-05 import/runtime interoperability; REUSE-05 to RUST-07 deployment; REUSE-06 to RUST-08 acceptance. These mappings are planning proposals, not completed work. See docs/reuse/AUDIT_SUMMARY.md.

REUSE-02A merged in #15 (`5173d9a`), legacy fixture #57 merged. REUSE-02B is a separate, unconnected source-only engine import with enforced hosted validation and unresolved advisory gate; see crates/hmi-engine/PROVENANCE.md.

REUSE-02B merged in PR #16 at `78f3a64`, exact-head CI and advisory gate passed. REUSE-02C requires PR #7, bounded subscriptions and supervised protocol bridge; no hardware acceptance yet.

REUSE-02C.1 merged in PR #17 (`dbdeeb2`), including bounded bridge supervision and independent pulse-starvation correction. RUST-06A tag foundation merged in PR #7. REUSE-02C.2 PR #18 completion candidate: bounded/coalesced subscriptions and generation-scoped isolated loopback resync implemented and locally tested; exact-head hosted CI and independent review pending. General EngineDriver and physical-source integration remain separate. See docs/reuse/REUSE_02C2_BRIDGE_DISPATCH.md. No physical PLC acceptance.

REUSE-02C.2 merged in PR #18 (9dc343b). REUSE-02C.3 isolated read-only EngineDriver integration and checked scalar translation candidate: local tests passed, independent review and exact-head hosted validation pending. See docs/reuse/REUSE_02C3_ENGINE_DRIVER.md.
